svg.text: IC VISION — Complete Circuit (NUCLEO-F401RE, firmware v4.1)
Pin labels: header name · MCU pin. Same-name tags (3V3 / GND) are the same net — feed them from the Nucleo POWER header via breadboard rails.
unplug USB before swapping the chip
Nucleo 3V3 → breadboard + rail (OLED VCC, INA219 VCC, INA219 VIN+) · Nucleo GND → breadboard − rail (all GND tags, socket pin 7)
R1–R12 = 1 kΩ (one per socket signal pin) · R13–R14 = 330 Ω · C1 = 100 nF · socket pins 7 and 14 have no resistor
